summary: SFL Corp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching its unaudited interim financial statements and MD&A for Q1 2026. The report covers routine quarterly operating results, including time charter, voyage charter, and drilling contract revenues, depreciation, impairment, and net income of $26 million. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, activist campaign, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic financial report with no event-driven corporate action.
